constraints: Use natural language similar to how a real employee would request a letter. Do not invent employee IDs or names — the bot shows them from its database.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: Employment letter - fetch details error handling
goal: When HR backend fails, bot shows 'issue in fetching your details' without breaking

phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with employee details card OR a clear 'issue in fetching your details' message (not empty/silent)
phases.recoveryHint: Try 'i want employment letter' after greeting
